scenes.title: Select MO 26 and MO 27
scenes.caption: In Orbitals, check rows 26 and 27. Set the isovalue magnitude to 0.03 and the grid to 128³, then generate both fields together.

scenes.title: Inspect the four signed meshes
scenes.caption: Saved surfaces lists one positive and one negative level for each orbital. Use the eye controls to show only one orbital at a time.

scenes.title: Ask for matched exports
scenes.caption: This HOMO export uses levels of −0.03 and +0.03 per bohr to the three halves. Keep the same camera and image dimensions for the LUMO.
scenes.prompt: Find the HOMO and LUMO. Generate both signed pairs at 128 samples per axis and export each orbital from the same camera.

scenes.title: Check the LUMO and keep the comparison
scenes.caption: Select the LUMO and refresh the rendering key before the second PNG. The four-row comparison CSV records both signed levels and the actual triangle counts.
scenes.prompt: Verify both PNGs and write a CSV with one row per mesh, its orbital ID, energy, occupation, isovalue and triangle count.
